The provided onboarding document does not explicitly specify a command or UI option to delete/remove an unusable model from the model list.

**Best Guess:**
Model configurations are managed in the main configuration file or setup wizard. You can likely remove or disable the model by:
1. Editing your configuration file at `~/.hermes/config.yaml` and removing the unusable model or provider entry under the model configuration section.
2. Re-running the interactive setup wizard via `hermes setup` to reconfigure your available providers/models.
